purpose: Explicit directional two-group comparison drafts bound to one saved sample design; no scientific calculation or implicit experiment design.
trustedSourceRules: Caller must first authorize project and obtain fully validated import descriptors and saved sample record. Pure modules do not authenticate.

Validate canonical UUIDs, family/dataset identity, original four-key sample descriptors, and the saved sample record schema/identities/design_sha256 using the existing frozen sample-design contract and canonical hash.
Payload sample_design_version_id must equal the exact saved record version; source mutation, dataset/family/sample-version change must invalidate old comparisons, not silently rebind.
Do not edit sample_design.py or frozen c19 validator; reuse it or preserve an unchanged test-only copy with explicit provenance.
draftRules: An empty contrasts list and empty numerator/denominator strings are permitted incomplete drafts.

Nonempty group choices must exactly equal nonblank manual groups in selected saved design rows; preserve Unicode scalar text/case and validate existing 80-codepoint group rules; no trimming/casefold/inference.
Every contrast_id is a unique canonical UUID. Fully specified ordered group pairs must be unique and numerator must differ from denominator.

A/B and B/A are distinct directional comparisons. UI must state FC = numerator/denominator, log2FC = log2(FC); positive effects mean numerator greater than denominator. Group abundance summaries and statistical-model effects are method-specific later gates. These are direction labels, not computed statistics.
Never hardcode WT, six contrasts, seven groups or three repeats. Do not infer groups/treatment/replication from column names.
Source saved sample drafts can be incomplete or unconfirmed; comparison drafts may still be edited, but source issues must remain visible.

viewRules.groupSummary: Exact manual group name, total selected-family columns and confirmed-column count; raw ordinals remain distinct.
viewRules.readyForMethodSelection: At least one complete valid contrast; every source row explicitly confirmed; existing sample design review has no issues; each included group's control flag is internally consistent, replicate_type biological, and replicate labels nonblank and unique within that group. Technical/mixed/unknown repetitions require a later explicit policy and remain blocked.
viewRules.notScientificReadiness: analysis_ready is always false in this slice; method-specific effective n, statistical method, processed matrix, batch/paired/multi-factor design and thresholds are subsequent gates. No p-value/FC results or analysis button.
viewRules.confirmation: No automatic confirmation of source samples or comparisons; user chooses every directional group pair.

scope.backend: Pure validation/review module and synthetic tests only; no migrations, HTTP route, DB, R, Auth or job execution.
scope.frontend: Standalone model/editor with bindSource/add/update/remove/view/exportDraft/dispose; no app mount, HTTP, persistence claim or new upload entrance in this task.
scope.errors: Fixed machine diagnostics for invalid source/IDs/schema/group choice/duplicate pair/same group. No arbitrary manual data in exception text.
scope.sourceContractLimits: Keep existing UTF-8 Unicode scalar, nonboolean safe integral JSON number semantics and immutable original identifiers.
